source.section: Form N-11 lines 7-12, 19-20 and 23-27 (pages 2-3); PDF page 11 (Line 7), PDF page 20 (Line 23 standard deduction table, Line 25 exemptions), PDF page 9 (Lines 6a, 6b, 'age 65 or over as of January 1, 2026'), PDF page 20 (Line 27 Tax Table), PDF page 50 (2025 Tax Rate Schedules); PDF page 13, Line 14 Social Security Benefits; Form N-11 line 14; PDF page 13 Line 13 Annuity Plans

worked: Married filing jointly, 68 and 66 (both 65 or over as of January 1, 2026): a traditional IRA the owner funded himself (no rollover money) 50,000, interest 10,000, Social Security 50,000 gross. The IRA is taxable (PDF page 13, Annuity Plans: self-funded IRAs are your own investments); Social Security is subtracted on line 14. Line 7 federal AGI = IRA distribution 50,000.00 + interest 10,000.00 + taxable Social Security 40,850.00 (federal worksheet: provisional income 60,000 + half of 50,000 = 85,000; 85% x (85,000 - 44,000) = 34,850 + the smaller of 6,000 or half the benefits = 6,000, total 40,850, under the 85% cap 42,500) = 100,850.00. Federal taxable income = 100,850.00 - 31,500.00 federal standard deduction - 2 x 1,600.00 age-65 addition = 66,150.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Line 11 total additions = 0.00; line 12 = 100,850.00 + 0.00 = 100,850.00. Line 14 Social Security benefits taxed on the federal return (Form 1040 line 6b) 40,850.00. Line 19 total subtractions = 40,850.00; line 20 Hawaii AGI = 100,850.00 - 40,850.00 = 60,000.00. Line 23 standard deduction (married filing jointly, PDF page 20 table) 8,800.00; line 24 = 60,000.00 - 8,800.00 = 51,200.00. Line 6e exemptions: 2 regular + 2 age 65 or over = 4; line 25 = 4 x 1,144.00 = 4,576.00. Line 26 taxable income = 51,200.00 - 4,576.00 = 46,624.00. Line 27 tax, Schedule II (PDF page 50) as bands on 46,624.00: 19,200.00 x 1.4% = 268.80; 9,600.00 x 3.2% = 307.20; 9,600.00 x 5.5% = 528.00; 8,224.00 x 6.4% = 526.336; sum = 1,630.336, to the cent 1,630.34; tax = 1,630.34 (Form N-11 line 27 uses the Tax Table below 100,000 of taxable income (PDF page 20, Line 27): the table row 46,600 to 46,650 gives 1,630; this case uses the bands as numbers). No credits modelled (refundable food/excise and renters credits, lines 28-29, not claimed): state income tax = 1,630.34.
